id./param/scenario/cs/a_180_cs_050.pack|cs_: "Huff... Huff... Och, climbing a mountain at my age plays havoc with my auld bones.
"We still have a way to go. We'll face Yggdrasil soon, so let's rest properly here.
"We finally head to Yggdrasil tomorrow. I'm getting nervous...
"Serena, play that song for me. The one you've played since we were children, from our hometown.
"Yggdrasil looks so magical at night. To think each of our lives is a leaf on those branches...
"Come to think of it, the old man said Yggdrasil gathers the world's life. Is that true?
"Yes. When someone dies their leaf falls, and when someone is born a new one buds. That is how life stays in balance.
"We'll face Mordegon soon. If we beat him, surely Father will go back to how he once was.
"Veronica, that flute... Do you play an instrument too?
"No. The High Priest gave it to me as a charm. It was left in Arboria by our ancestor, the sage Serenica.
"Right, everyone. Enough chatter, let's rest. Staying up late is a lady's worst enemy!
"You and I will bud and fall at the same time, won't we?
"You're so slow, Serena. I'm not sure.
